title: Critical tribes influence dimension limit
statement: For each natural number $w$, let $s_w$ be the greatest natural number at most $2^{w+2}$ such that $1-(1-2^{-w})^{s_w}\le 1/2$, and set $d_w=s_w w$ and $I_w=2^{-(w-1)}(1-2^{-w})^{\max(s_w-1,0)}$. As $w$ tends to infinity, $I_w d_w/\log(d_w)$ tends to $1$.
